categories.question: You have one empty jar to grow something on your kitchen windowsill. What goes in?

outcomes.name: A sprouting avocado stone
outcomes.description: Avocado pit suspended with toothpicks above a clear jar, one sprout and roots

outcomes.name: A basil cutting
outcomes.description: Fragrant basil cutting with fresh white roots visible in a short jar

outcomes.name: A regrowing spring onion
outcomes.description: Green onion bulbs with roots and new dark green shoots in a glass

outcomes.name: A sweet potato vine
outcomes.description: Small orange sweet potato in a jar with trailing heart-shaped green leaves
